title.narrative: Mejoramiento de la Calidad de Educacin

description.narrative: El objetivo principal del programa es de mejorar la calidad de la educaicon primaria y el sistema de gobernanza del sistema educativo. Los objetivos especificos son: (i) capacitar aproximadamente el 50 % de los instructores de metodods de ensenanza de los insititutos de formacion docente (TEI) y el 46% de los docentes en servicio; (ii) capacitar aproximadamente el 37 % de los directores de colegio a niveles de la educacion primaria y seconduaria; y (iii) desarrollar un sistema de gestion educativa (EMIS) para el 100% de los colegios de primaria y secundaria; y (iv) mejorar el perfil de los candidatos a los TEIs.

The main objective of the Program is to improve the quality of primary education and the governance of the Belize education system. The specific objectives are to: (i) train approximately 50 percent of TEI (Teacher Education Institutes) pre-service instructors teaching methods courses and 46 percent of in-service teachers at the primary level; (ii) train approximately 37 percent of primary school principals in instructional leadership and administration; (iii) develop and implement an EMIS (Education Management Information System) for 100% of schools at the primary and secondary levels; and (iv) improve the profile of teacher candidates.
